content:
**Spoiled Vegetables** are a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

Spoiled Vegetables will appear in the player character's inventory whenever a piece of edible vegetation has fully rotted. While they can still be used as a food item, the player character has a severe risk of catching a disease and should only be consumed as a last resort. A more practical use for the Spoiled Vegetable is to convert it into Raw Fertilizer at a Chemistry Station, at a rate of 10 Spoiled Vegetables for one Raw Fertilizer.

Replaces vegetables in the player character's inventory when they become spoiled.
